# netbox_circuit_group_assignment (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/circuits/circuitgroupassignment/):

> Circuit group assignments are used to associate a circuit (or virtual circuit) with a circuit group, optionally indicating its priority within that group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_circuit_provider" "providera" {
    name = "ProviderA"
    slug = "providera"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_type" "typea" {
    name = "TypeA"
    slug = "typea"
}

resource "netbox_circuit" "circuita" {
    cid         = "CID12345"
    status      = "active"
    provider_id = netbox_circuit_provider.providera.id
    type_id     = netbox_circuit_type.typea.id
}

resource "netbox_circuit_group" "groupa" {
    name = "GroupA"
    slug = "groupa"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_group_assignment" "assignmenta" {
    group_id    = netbox_circuit_group.groupa.id
    member_type = "circuits.circuit"
    member_id   = netbox_circuit.circuita.id
    priority    = "primary"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the circuit group this assignment belongs to.
- `member_id` (Number) The ID of the assigned member (circuit or virtual circuit).
- `member_type` (String) The content type of the assigned member, e.g. `circuits.circuit` or `circuits.virtualcircuit`.

### Optional

- `priority` (String) Valid values are `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `inactive`
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
